channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Israeli air strikes kill 41 people in Lebanon in 24-hour window
item.description: Death toll from Israeli attacks on Lebanon since March 2 has reached 2,659, with 8,183 others injured.

item.title: Trump says US Navy acting ‘like pirates’ to enforce Iran blockade
item.description: The US president says the ongoing naval blockade of the Strait of Hormuz is 'a very profitable business'.

item.title: China’s UN Envoy: Hormuz closure will dominate Trump-Xi talks
item.description: China's UN Ambassador Fu Cong says maintaining the ceasefire and reopening the Strait of Hormuz are “urgent” priorities.

item.title: China urges reversal of UNIFIL departure from Lebanon as conflict escalates
item.description: The UNIFIL mission has faced a growing number of casualties as Israel and Hezbollah continue to fight.

item.title: Iran war: What’s happening on day 64 as Trump rejects Tehran’s proposal
item.description: US President Donald Trump says the latest Iranian peace proposal includes demands he 'can’t agree to'.

item.title: Trump says US forces are ‘like pirates’ taking Iranian oil
item.description: Donald Trump says US forces are ‘like pirates’ taking over Iranian ships and cargo near the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Iran war protester speaks to Al Jazeera from top of Washington bridge
item.description: A 45-year old man is occupying the top of Washington’s Frederick Douglass Memorial Bridge to protest the war on Iran.

item.title: US to cut troop levels in Germany by 5,000 amid Trump spat with Merz
item.description: The decision to reduce the US deployment to Germany comes amid a row between the two allies over Iran.

item.title: US threatens shipping firms with sanctions if they pay Iran tolls
item.description: The warning comes as President Donald Trump said he was "not excited" by Iran's latest proposal for a peace deal.

item.title: Thirteen killed in Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon, health ministry says
item.description: Four women and a child are among the dead, as fighting between Israel and Iran-backed Hezbollah continues despite a ceasefire.
